description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget `TaskFormPage` used for creating and editing tasks within a task management app. It includes UI components for task details such as title, description, priority, status, project association, due date/time, and tags, along with functionality for saving and deleting tasks.

classes.name: TaskFormPage
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget for creating or editing a task.

classes.name: _TaskFormPageState
classes.description: State class for `TaskFormPage`, managing form state, input controllers, and task operations.

classes.name: _PriorityPicker
classes.description: A widget for selecting the task priority.

classes.name: _StatusPicker
classes.description: A widget for selecting the task status.

classes.name: _ProjectPicker
classes.description: A widget for selecting the associated project, fetching projects via stream.

classes.name: _TagsPicker
classes.description: A widget for selecting tags associated with the task, with internal state to manage selected tags.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes form fields with existing task data if editing an existing task.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of text controllers when widget is removed.

methods.name: _pickDueDateTime
methods.description: Displays date and time pickers to select or modify the task's due date/time.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Validates form, prepares task object, and calls repository to save (upsert) the task.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Deletes the current task via repository.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI form for task creation/editing, including fields for title, description, project, priority, status, due date/time, tags, and save/delete buttons.
